recommendation: Keep the empty audit commit as-is. No FHIR core follow-up is needed for FHIR-16131; future semantic changes to quantity-precision should be made in the FHIR Extension Pack, with core cross-reference updates only if the link or guidance changes.
issue_request: FHIR-16131 was Published with resolution Persuasive with Modification. It requested a Quantity precision attribute; the final disposition was to define an explicit precision extension for conversion to and from non-FHIR representations, while FHIR calculations and rendering remain driven by the implicit precision of the represented decimal value.
initial_application: The original application was extension-based. Commit a5c90c3db3cc87902faf8b096c1fdc5f179853fc added the active fhir.ini quantity-extensions profile entry for GF#16131, and the immediately following build-fix commit e20e51a90b117925e85a233979371f2ed3d0c1fc added the quantity-extensions spreadsheet precision row with explicit precision semantics.
additional_context: The core source later removed extension definitions in dd468d4f1799dd79819315b211588ef1cf4586e0 as part of the R5 source split to the FHIR Extension Pack. The current Extension Pack defines StructureDefinition/quantity-precision as active with Quantity and decimal contexts, integer value, and the same note that rendering and calculations still use the raw decimal value. FHIR-51527 later published and implemented the Quantity context expansion. Current core source says Quantity.value has implicit precision and the JSON decimal page links to the precision extension.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Reintroducing the extension definition into core or adding redundant Quantity prose would conflict with the current extension-pack ownership model and would not change implementer understanding.
